'''Lake Yinta''' was the largest freshwater lake on the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Vulta]]. The lake was ringed by the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Yinta Lake]], and emitted a scent of decay that permeated the metropolis.
